newsitem.title: USA: Arvida/JMB tells Raleigh its not for sale.
newsitem.headline: Arvida/JMB tells Raleigh its not for sale.

text.p: Arvida/JMB Partners LP said it has advised Raleigh Capital Associates LP that its business is not for sale.

Arvida/JMB was responding to a business combination proposal made by Raleigh in which the limited partners of Arvida/JMB would be given the choice of $500 in cash for each unit held or a combination of $400 in cash plus a continuing interest in the entity valued at $125, or a total of $525.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Arvida/JMB, a Boca Raton, Fla.,-based real estate developer described the proposal as "very general and lacks specifics."
It added that the proposal "values the Partnership's business for significantly less than the Partnership believes it is worth."

Raleigh, which holds a 19.7 percent stake in Arvida/JMB, had been opposed to a $160 million financing deal between the developer and Starwood Capital Group LP and had offered an alternative deal which Arvida/JMB had rejected.
In the filing, Arvida/JMB said it and a Starwood affiliate entered into a commitment for the term loan on September 12.
